## Overview

This is the earlier AOI-level differential-expression arm. It runs in each of the nine RUV-4-normalised strata from comp_02, where artefact probes and RLE outlier AOIs have already been removed. Expression is modelled with `variancePartition::dream` (voomWithDreamWeights), with a random intercept per patient so that AOIs from the same patient are not treated as independent. The outcome is continuous PSA change, capped at +100% and scaled per 50%, and the model is fitted under three specifications: A, PSA + RUV-4 factors W; B, PSA + study batch (no RUV); C, PSA + W + logit deconvolved tumour fraction. A non-responder versus responder contrast on specification A is fitted in baseline strata with at least three non-responders; Cycle1 strata are excluded.

Genes are called robust only if all of the following hold: FDR < 0.1 in at least two of A/B/C; the same sign in all three specifications and in a patient-level pseudobulk limma-voom fit (PSA + majority batch); and sign stability of at least 90% across leave-one-patient-out pseudobulk refits. Gene-set enrichment uses fgsea on specification-A t statistics (Hallmark, Reactome, KEGG, GO:BP; 15–500 genes). The manuscript's primary inference is patient-level pseudobulk on the LOQ gene universe, run in later scripts. These AOI-level results form part of the reconciliation with earlier analyses.

**Manuscript items supported**

- Supplementary Table 7 (robust genes), Supplementary Table 8 (DE summary per stratum) and Supplementary Table 9 (fgsea, FDR < 0.05), written to the workbook by comp_11
- Methods: Reconciliation with earlier analyses and the standR workflow (earlier AOI-level models)

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --only 04_de`. Approximate runtime: long (three or four dream fits per stratum plus leave-one-patient-out refits; parallel over PRINCE_MAX_WORKERS); strata already written are reloaded on a rerun.

**Inputs**

- `results/C2_normalization/normalized_strata.qs`
- `results/C3_deconvolution/deconvolution_proportions.qs`
- `data/reference/msigdb_gene_sets.rds`

**Outputs**

- `results/C4_DE/<stratum>_dream_psa_specs.csv`
- `results/C4_DE/<stratum>_fgsea_psa.csv`
- `results/C4_DE/de_summary.csv`
- `results/C4_DE/de_results.qs`
- `results/C4_DE/robust_genes_all_strata.csv`

**Depends on**: `comp_02_normalize`, `comp_03b_deconv`

## Analysis

Script header: model specifications, the robustness definition and the gene-set tests.

### Set-up and model helpers
Reads the normalised strata, the epithelial-tumour fraction from deconvolution (logit-transformed, bounded at 0.01–0.99) and the MSigDB collections. Helpers:
- `run_dream()`: TMM, voomWithDreamWeights and dream with eBayes, returning the full table for one coefficient;
- `pseudobulk()`: sums counts per patient and assigns each patient's majority batch;
- `pb_fit()`: limma-voom on the pseudobulk with ~ outcome + batch, dropping batch if it is constant or aliased.

```{r comp-04-de-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE comprehensive analysis -- C4: differential expression with patient random effects
## Per stratum (C2 output; artefact probes + RLE outliers already removed):
##   dream (variancePartition::voomWithDreamWeights + dream), random intercept per patient
##   Outcome: continuous PSA change (capped at +100%, per 50%) -- all patients
##   Specs:   A = psa + RUV-4 W
##            B = psa + study_batch (no RUV)
##            C = psa + RUV-4 W + logit(deconvolved tumour fraction, C3)
##   NR vs R (Intermediate excluded) on spec A, baseline strata only (Cycle1 has 2 NR pts)
##   Robustness: patient-level pseudobulk limma-voom (psa + majority batch), and
##               leave-one-patient-out (LOPO) pseudobulk for candidate genes
##   "Robust" gene: FDR < 0.1 in >= 2 of A/B/C, same sign in pseudobulk, LOPO sign
##   stability >= 90%.
##   Gene-set tests: fgsea on spec-A t-statistics (H, Reactome, KEGG, GO:BP).
## ============================================================================

source(file.path(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."), ".build", "comp_00_guard.R"))
suppressMessages({
  library(qs); library(dplyr); library(limma); library(edgeR); library(variancePartition)
  library(BiocParallel); library(fgsea); library(ggplot2)
})
setwd(PRINCE_DIR)
check_ram_or_stop(20)
bp <- SnowParam(workers = MAX_WORKERS, progressbar = FALSE)

norm <- qs::qread(out_path("C2_normalization", "normalized_strata.qs"), nthreads = 1)
dec <- qs::qread(out_path("C3_deconvolution", "deconvolution_proportions.qs"))
tum_frac <- c(dec$lineage_primary[, "Epithelial_tumour"], dec$lineage_bone[, "Epithelial_tumour"])
msig <- readRDS(file.path(PMCC_DIR, "msigdb_gene_sets.rds"))
gsets <- c(msig$H, msig$C2_CP_REAC, msig$C2_CP_KEGG, msig$C5_BP)
logit <- function(p) { p <- pmin(pmax(p, 0.01), 0.99); log(p / (1 - p)) }

run_dream <- function(counts, d, form, coef) {
  dge <- calcNormFactors(DGEList(counts))
  v <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, d, BPPARAM = bp)
  fit <- eBayes(dream(v, form, d, BPPARAM = bp))
  topTable(fit, coef = coef, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
}
pseudobulk <- function(counts, d, outcome) {
  pb <- sapply(split(seq_len(nrow(d)), d$subject_id), function(i) rowSums(counts[, i, drop = FALSE]))
  pd <- d %>% group_by(subject_id) %>%
    summarise(y = first(.data[[outcome]]),
              batch = names(sort(table(study_batch), decreasing = TRUE))[1], .groups = "drop")
  pd <- pd[match(colnames(pb), pd$subject_id), ]
  list(pb = pb, pd = pd)
}
pb_fit <- function(pb, pd) {
  dge <- calcNormFactors(DGEList(pb))
  X <- if (length(unique(pd$batch)) > 1) model.matrix(~ y + batch, pd) else model.matrix(~ y, pd)
  if (qr(X)$rank < ncol(X)) X <- model.matrix(~ y, pd)
  fit <- eBayes(lmFit(voom(dge, X), X))
  topTable(fit, coef = "y", number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
}

```

### Per-stratum models
For each stratum, previously written results are reloaded if present; otherwise:
- fits specifications A (~ psa + W + (1|patient)), B (~ psa + study_batch + (1|patient)) and C (~ psa + W + tumour + (1|patient)), plus the patient pseudobulk fit;
- in Archival and Screening strata with at least three non-responder patients, fits ~ NR + W + (1|patient) with intermediate patients excluded;
- marks candidate genes (FDR < 0.1 in ≥ 2 specifications, consistent sign across specifications and with pseudobulk), then refits the pseudobulk leaving out each patient in turn. Candidates with ≥ 90% sign agreement are called robust;
- runs fgsea on specification-A t statistics.

Per-stratum tables are written as they finish. The summary, combined results, robust-gene list and specification-A P-value histograms follow.

```{r comp-04-de-02}
all_res <- list(); robust_all <- list(); gsea_all <- list(); summ <- list()
for (sid in names(norm)) {
  nm <- norm[[sid]]
  cat("\n==========", sid, "==========\n")
  ## resume: strata already written by an earlier (interrupted) run are reloaded, not refitted
  de_file <- out_path("C4_DE", paste0(sid, "_dream_psa_specs.csv"))
  gs_file <- out_path("C4_DE", paste0(sid, "_fgsea_psa.csv"))
  if (file.exists(de_file) && file.exists(gs_file)) {
    res <- read.csv(de_file); gs <- read.csv(gs_file)
    all_res[[sid]] <- res; gsea_all[[sid]] <- gs
    summ[[sid]] <- data.frame(stratum = sid, n_aoi = nrow(nm$cd), n_pt = length(unique(nm$cd$subject_id)),
                              n_NR_pt = length(unique(nm$cd$subject_id[nm$cd$response_group_neat == "Non_Responder"])),
                              n_genes = nrow(res), fdr10_A = sum(res$FDR_A < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
                              fdr10_B = sum(res$FDR_B < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE), fdr10_C = sum(res$FDR_C < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
                              robust = sum(res$robust, na.rm = TRUE), fdr10_NR = sum(res$FDR_NR < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
                              pathways_fdr05 = sum(gs$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE))
    cat("reloaded from", basename(de_file), "\n"); next
  }
  counts <- nm$counts
  d <- nm$cd %>% mutate(psa = psa_change_capped / 50, tumour = logit(tum_frac[rownames(nm$cd)]))
  W <- nm$W; colnames(W) <- paste0("W", seq_len(ncol(W))); d <- cbind(d, W)
  wterms <- paste(colnames(W), collapse = " + ")
  if (length(unique(d$study_batch)) < 2) stop("single batch in ", sid)

  fA <- as.formula(paste("~ psa +", wterms, "+ (1|subject_id)"))
  fB <- ~ psa + study_batch + (1|subject_id)
  fC <- as.formula(paste("~ psa +", wterms, "+ tumour + (1|subject_id)"))
  tA <- run_dream(counts, d, fA, "psa"); tB <- run_dream(counts, d, fB, "psa"); tC <- run_dream(counts, d, fC, "psa")

  pbl <- pseudobulk(counts, d, "psa")
  tP <- pb_fit(pbl$pb, pbl$pd)

  # align by gene: dream can drop a gene whose model fails to converge in one spec
  g <- rownames(tA)
  res <- data.frame(stratum = sid, gene = g,
                    logFC_A = tA$logFC, t_A = tA$t, P_A = tA$P.Value, FDR_A = tA$adj.P.Val,
                    logFC_B = tB[g, "logFC"], FDR_B = tB[g, "adj.P.Val"],
                    logFC_C = tC[g, "logFC"], FDR_C = tC[g, "adj.P.Val"],
                    logFC_PB = tP[g, "logFC"], P_PB = tP[g, "P.Value"])

  ## NR vs R (baseline strata only)
  dn <- d %>% filter(response_group_neat %in% c("Responder", "Non_Responder")) %>%
    mutate(NR = as.integer(response_group_neat == "Non_Responder"))
  n_nr_pt <- length(unique(dn$subject_id[dn$NR == 1]))
  if (!grepl("Cycle1", sid) && n_nr_pt >= 3) {
    fN <- as.formula(paste("~ NR +", wterms, "+ (1|subject_id)"))
    tN <- run_dream(counts[, rownames(dn)], dn, fN, "NR")
    res$logFC_NR <- tN[g, "logFC"]; res$P_NR <- tN[g, "P.Value"]; res$FDR_NR <- tN[g, "adj.P.Val"]
  } else { res$logFC_NR <- NA; res$P_NR <- NA; res$FDR_NR <- NA }

  ## robustness for psa
  res$n_specs_fdr10 <- (res$FDR_A < 0.1) + (res$FDR_B < 0.1) + (res$FDR_C < 0.1)
  res$specs_same_sign <- sign(res$logFC_A) == sign(res$logFC_B) & sign(res$logFC_A) == sign(res$logFC_C)
  res$pb_same_sign <- sign(res$logFC_A) == sign(res$logFC_PB)
  cand <- res$gene[which(res$n_specs_fdr10 >= 2 & res$specs_same_sign & res$pb_same_sign)]
  res$lopo_stability <- NA
  if (length(cand)) {
    pts <- colnames(pbl$pb)
    lopo <- sapply(pts, function(p) {
      keep <- pts != p
      tt <- pb_fit(pbl$pb[, keep], pbl$pd[keep, ])
      sign(tt[cand, "logFC"]) == sign(res$logFC_A[match(cand, res$gene)])
    })
    res$lopo_stability[match(cand, res$gene)] <- rowMeans(matrix(lopo, nrow = length(cand)))
  }
  res$robust <- res$gene %in% cand & !is.na(res$lopo_stability) & res$lopo_stability >= 0.9

  ## fgsea on spec-A t statistics
  st <- setNames(res$t_A, res$gene)
  set.seed(2026)  # fgsea p-values are permutation-based; fixed seed makes Table S9 reproducible
  gs <- fgsea(gsets, st, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, nproc = 1)
  gs <- gs %>% arrange(padj) %>% mutate(stratum = sid, leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";"))

  s <- data.frame(stratum = sid, n_aoi = nrow(d), n_pt = length(unique(d$subject_id)),
                  n_NR_pt = n_nr_pt, n_genes = nrow(res),
                  fdr10_A = sum(res$FDR_A < 0.1), fdr10_B = sum(res$FDR_B < 0.1), fdr10_C = sum(res$FDR_C < 0.1),
                  robust = sum(res$robust), fdr10_NR = sum(res$FDR_NR < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
                  pathways_fdr05 = sum(gs$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE))
  print(s, row.names = FALSE)
  if (sum(res$robust)) {
    cat("Robust genes (top 25 by P_A):\n")
    print(head(res %>% filter(robust) %>% arrange(P_A) %>%
                 select(gene, logFC_A, FDR_A, FDR_B, FDR_C, logFC_PB, lopo_stability), 25), row.names = FALSE)
  }
  cat("Top pathways:\n"); print(head(as.data.frame(gs[, c("pathway", "NES", "padj")]), 10), row.names = FALSE)

  all_res[[sid]] <- res; gsea_all[[sid]] <- gs; summ[[sid]] <- s
  write.csv(res, out_path("C4_DE", paste0(sid, "_dream_psa_specs.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(gs, out_path("C4_DE", paste0(sid, "_fgsea_psa.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

summ <- bind_rows(summ)
cat("\n================ C4 SUMMARY ================\n"); print(summ, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(summ, out_path("C4_DE", "de_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
qs::qsave(list(genes = all_res, gsea = gsea_all), out_path("C4_DE", "de_results.qs"))
write.csv(bind_rows(lapply(all_res, function(r) r[r$robust, ])), out_path("C4_DE", "robust_genes_all_strata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

pdf(out_path("C4_DE", "pvalue_histograms_specA.pdf"), width = 12, height = 9)
par(mfrow = c(3, 3)); for (sid in names(all_res)) hist(all_res[[sid]]$P_A, breaks = 50, main = sid, xlab = "P (spec A, psa)")
dev.off()
cat("\nC4 complete.\n")
```
